pages.title: Nutrition HUD
pages.text: Nourished adds a compact HUD overlay so you can monitor your nutrition without opening the Diet Screen.$(br2)The HUD shows animated bars for each food group that update in real time as you eat.$(br2)$(bold)Customizing the HUD:$()$(br2)Press $(k:nourished.hud_edit) to enter HUD edit mode. From there you can:$(br2)$(li)Drag the overlay to any position$(li)Resize it to your preference
